wherei.title: Meet Remi, your AI biographer
wherei.caption: Remi greets you by name and asks where to begin. Surprise Me and Select a Prompt remove the blank-page problem that stops most people recording their lives.

wherei.title: Ready to listen
wherei.caption: An open composer with voice and text. Remi speaks in a large serif, so the biographer reads as a narrator rather than another chat bubble.

wherei.title: Room for a real story
wherei.caption: The composer grows to fit a long answer. Built for storytelling, not one-line replies.

wherei.title: Long answers fold away
wherei.caption: Sent messages collapse to four lines so the conversation stays scannable and the next question is always the biggest thing on screen.

wherei.title: Talking builds the map
wherei.caption: When Remi recognises a place in your answer, a 'New place logged' marker appears, showing that the conversation is quietly building your map.

wherei.title: Answering the follow-up
wherei.caption: Mid-reply to Remi's next question. The thread reads like an interview, not a form.

wherei.title: The interview continues
wherei.caption: Earlier exchanges blur behind the header as the conversation moves forward.

wherei.title: Voice mode with real follow-ups
wherei.caption: Remi asks contextual questions ('Is that when you moved to Bed-Stuy?'), drawing out detail the way a good journalist would.

wherei.title: A map of the people you love
wherei.caption: Home is a shared map of your circle's memories. Tap a pin to see where Sam had his first job; new memories show as a ring on each person.
wherei.orig: 10 A map of the people you love.png

wherei.title: Memories pinned in place
wherei.caption: A pin with a photo thumbnail: 'where Sam met his wife'. Every memory title completes the product name.

wherei.title: Ask everyone's lives a question
wherei.caption: Search reads 'remember'. A query like 'went to college' returns pins from several people at once, with Remi one tap away.
wherei.notes: Alternative tab bar with oversized Remi orb [confirm whether exploration or state]

wherei.title: One person's life, on a map
wherei.caption: Filtered to Sam: his pins plus a carousel of memory cards with 3D map thumbnails and a Map / Timeline toggle.
wherei.orig: 13 One person's life, on a map.png

wherei.title: From conversation to keepsake
wherei.caption: Remi turns raw answers into a finished, illustrated story. By Remi / By Sam tabs, 'See original input' and image sources show exactly who wrote what.
wherei.notes: Best screen for the AI-trust story

wherei.title: Your life at a glance
wherei.caption: A globe of every place you've logged and an age dial around your photo. The timeline groups years by age, with Remi's summary of each year.
